'''Sinclair Mansion''' is a large mansion owned by the Sinclair family that plays a significant role in the [[Murder Mystery]] [[Quests|quest]]. It is located north of [[Camelot]], along the path that leads from [[Seers' Village]] to [[Rellekka]]. The [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|cjr}} is located just west of the mansion. An [[Agility]] [[shortcut]] north of the mansion leads to [[Fremennik Province]] (48 Agility required).

==Transportation==
The fastest way to Sinclair Mansion is via [[fairy ring]], using code {{Fairycode|cjr}}. Other routes include:
* [[Music cape]] teleport to [[Falo the Bard]], then run east.
* Teleport to [[Camelot]] or [[Seers' Village]] via the Camelot Teleport [[Camelot Teleport|spell]] or [[Camelot teleport (tablet)|tablet]], then running north along the road.
* [[Kandarin headgear]] teleport to [[Sherlock]], then run north.
* Travel to [[Catherby]] via the Catherby Teleport [[Catherby Teleport|spell]] or [[Catherby teleport (tablet)|tablet]] or by [[charter ship]], then run north-west to the road between Camelot and the Seers' Village bank.

==Features==
Sinclair Mansion has [[cabbage]], [[grain]], and [[potato]] spawns, as well as a [[willow tree]]. A [[Barrel of flour (Sinclair Mansion)|barrel of flour]] that serves as an infinite source for filling [[pot of flour|pots of flour]] is located in the kitchen. A [[dairy churn]] is located outside the garden shed.
